title: Occupational Health and Safety Institute v James Mataliro (SCZ No.8/ 14/2022) [2025] ZMSC 1 (15 January 2025)
case_name: Occupational Health and Safety Institute v James Mataliro
outcome_detail: Leave to appeal to the Supreme Court granted; threshold under s 13(3) Court of Appeal Act met — points of law of public importance on Legal Practitioners' Practice Rules (in-house vs private practice) and reasonable prospect of success on procedural-fairness issue (Court of Appeal resolving contested factual issues without retrial).
